assertions.subject: Gingival Granuloma
assertions.comparator: phenytoin, calcium channel blockers (e.g., nifedipine), and cyclosporine
assertions.quote: Gingival hyperplasia may be caused by phenytoin, calcium channel blockers (e.g., nifedipine), and cyclosporine, though excellent daily oral care can prevent or reduce its occurrence

assertions.subject: idiopathic familial gingival fibromatosis
assertions.quote: Idiopathic familial gingival fibromatosis and several syndrome-related disorders cause similar conditions

assertions.subject: HIV infection
assertions.quote: Linear gingival erythema is variably seen in patients with advanced HIV infection and probably represents immune deficiency and decreased neutrophil activity

assertions.subject: acute myelomonocytic leukemia
assertions.quote: Diffuse or focal gingival swelling may be a feature of early or late acute myelomonocytic leukemia as well as of other lymphoproliferative disorders

assertions.subject: granulomatosis with polyangiitis
assertions.quote: A rare but pathognomonic sign of granulomatosis with polyangiitis is a red-purplish, granular gingivitis (strawberry gums)
